evidence: Walked all 55 scored/gate criteria (2 gate binaries, 43 functional binaries, 5 polish binaries, 5 visual likert in tests/*/*/judge.toml) against the frozen golden source; every criterion has a plausible satisfying path. SERVER (solution/app/src/index.js): one-stage rule FLOW index diff !== 1 (l.253); reject needs a non-blank reason and is refused from HIRED (l.248-250); reopen only to rejected_from (l.252), reason cleared, and undo restores rejected_from/reject_reason from before_json (l.302-303, l.365); Interview places counted for the whole set while reorder inside Interview is exempt because entering = cards not already in Interview (l.290-295); undo refused when any card's version != version_after (l.354), on overfill (l.357-359), and once undone or when not the latest action (l.350-351); reorder bumps version (l.312), so Mei's in-stage reorder of W blocks undo (B14) while Mei's reorder of Y only rewrites A2's position (writeColumn, no version change) so the B12 undo goes ahead; notes create no action, so after A2's undo a repeat undo is refused and Z stays in Screen (hro_undo_once). Stale move: 409 message embeds the last activity detail, e.g. 'Mei Lin moved F from Screen to Applied' (l.241-244), satisfying hro_stale_refused by name. Bulk arrival rank = stage index*100000+position (l.284-288) gives Y,W,X and A2,V. Manager rules l.257-264 (own job; origin and target within Interview/Offer/Hired; reopening a Screen rejection refused); POST /api/jobs and /api/applications are auth('recruiter') -> 403 for managers/observer/candidate; anonymous callers get 401 from auth() on every API incl. /api/bootstrap (board + Activity read), move, bulk, undo, notes and messages. Job open rejects blank title/team, a non-hiring-manager manager_id and non-integer/0/51 places (l.204-207; client turns '2.5' into NaN -> null, board.js l.72). Email regex plus case-insensitive per-job duplicate with field 'candidate_email' (l.221-224), shown at the email field with the name kept (board.js l.52-56). Candidate read model returns only id, job_title, team, status label, unread, message_count, last_message (l.171-176); staffOnly/application() give candidates 404 for other cards and conversations (l.121-131, l.378-385); the SSE payload is 'data: 1' only. Thread access: recruiter write, observer read, own manager write, candidate own (l.114-120). Unread = messages after last_read_id not by self, and sending marks read (l.133, l.425); seen boundary uses the candidate's read for staff messages and recruiter-or-job-manager reads for candidate messages, observer excluded (l.143-150). Paging 30 with earlier_count (l.409-416; seed thread_page_size = 30). Seeding once (db.js seedIfEmpty guarded by users count); seed read markers convert read_count to message ids. Computed from the seed: Lena unread on APP-301 = 1; Platform Engineer Applied Greta, Ade, Marco / Screen Priya, Samuel; Noor APP-101 note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.'; APP-101 has 120 messages, created_at monotone per conversation; environment and solution seed sha256 identical (a1c65c80...). CLIENT: non-drag Move select, Up/Down buttons, checkboxes and bulk bar (board.js l.208-243, l.285-290); optimistic move with snapshot put-back, reason in role=alert and focus returned to the card's select (l.166-171, l.181-199) for hro_refused_put_back; live updates via SSE 'changed' -> debounced /api/bootstrap with keyed in-place patching; card detail and note textarea sit outside the re-rendered columns and focus is restored (l.321-341) for hro_live_board / hro_pol_live_board; messages appended not rebuilt, scrolled-up arrival increments a pending pill without moving scroll and without markRead (threads.js l.145-159); loading earlier keeps the scrollTop offset (l.160-175; the log is its own 46vh scroll container, styles.css l.136); Enter / Shift+Enter, blank refused client-side (server also 400), box cleared and refocused (l.183-201), body white-space: pre-wrap; reply and note drafts in localStorage keyed hireops.<userId>.* (app.js l.39-43) so they survive switching, reload and session loss and are invisible to Mei; 401 -> sessionLost() sign-in prompt with nothing sent (app.js l.34, l.189-195); fetch failure -> 'Not sent.' with text kept (app.js l.31, threads.js l.194). Activity lines name actor, card, stages, reason and each card of every undo, newest first, per-job filter (index.js l.189, l.266-271, l.366; app.js l.45-85). Visual: coherent token palette and type scale in styles.css. RUNTIME EVIDENCE: raw-evidence-index.json artifact hashes recomputed (workspace.cjs, results/workspace.json, server.log and 3 PNGs all match) and every listed solution file hash matches the frozen task bytes; results/workspace.json reports 25/25 scripted golden groups passed with page_errors [] (live arrival 805 ms). The index scope states that full configured grading, workload, reward discrimination and Oracle scores are absent and that the driver does not walk every Functional criterion as the judge would. RESIDUAL RISKS (why risk=true): (1) No configured judge run or Oracle score exists, so 'the oracle can score high' is plausible from source and scripted observation but unmeasured; the long Functional protocol (Z,S,M,L,C,B,N,T,U,K,R,V,A,D with many independent contexts and replays) has no measured judge duration against timeout=9000, and budget exhaustion returns NOT EXERCISED -> 0 for golden rows. (2) hro_seen U-step: the candidate UI shows the list and the open conversation pane side by side with no closed-conversation state; if the judge treats the always-visible list as 'moved to his applications list' without opening another conversation or reloading, Tomas's still-open pane auto-marks Rafael's new message read (threads.js l.157) and Seen appears too early, failing the golden; reload or opening his Data Analyst conversation avoids it. (3) hro_unread_counts 'does not rise' leg: with the conversation open at its newest, the nav total badge briefly shows +1 between the bootstrap refresh and the markRead round-trip (app.js l.115-121 recomputes the nav badge only on the next refresh); an immediate snapshot after a wait-for could catch the blip, while the >=15 s snapshot would not. (4) The Activity view pages 50 lines behind 'Show more' (app.js l.79-80); the judge must expand it to see every J1/J2 line.
suggested_fix: No source fix required for row 18. Close the evidence gap with one full configured judge run (both gates and all three scored dimensions) on these frozen bytes, recording Functional duration against timeout=9000; optionally have protocol U say to reload Tomas's page or open his other conversation so the seen leg does not depend on judge interpretation.
run_verdict: PARTIAL - scripted golden observations (25/25 groups, hash-matched to the frozen bytes) confirm the main behaviours; no configured judge or Oracle run exists, so criterion-by-criterion judge scoring is NOT EXERCISED.
